name: bundle-budget-check
description: Check the JavaScript and CSS each page of a front-end build loads against size budgets, so bundles cannot grow unnoticed. Reads a Vite manifest, a Next.js build or a folder of files, measures raw, gzip and brotli sizes, and fails the pipeline when a page goes over its budget. Never runs the build, no dependencies.
author: INNERLUXES <info@innerluxes.dev>
